Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/c3b602eff132b326f388ba2415adf082ac150c72 c3b602e] (14 October 2020).
